name: effect-heavy typography edits (After Effects style)
summary: WGvtliE1298 is a 16.8 s (plus a 4.3 s end card) 1920x1080 @30 typography AMV over Djo "End of Beginning", letterboxed to 2:1. It is a published After Effects project-file showcase, so it is the most effect-dense reference in the set: 32 distinct effect instances, 1.9 per second, 5.7 per bar.

The text is the subject and the lyric is the clock. Words become legible a median of 2.5 frames (83 ms) after the vocal-stem onset of their syllable, and the seven shot joins deliberately sit OFF the percussion beat (join phase 0.64 +- 0.12 of the 160 bpm pulse) so nothing competes with the word.

Every word lives in 3D: it has a depth, the camera reaches it, it grows x1.11 per frame to 13-25% of the picture height, and it exits by passing the lens motion blurred. Up to three words are alive at once at different depths. It never fades out.

Every join is hidden inside an extreme state. The two whips ramp their displacement geometrically at x1.30-1.48 per frame for 8-14 frames to 11-17% of the frame width in a single frame, one going to white (alpha 0.72) and one to black (alpha 0.71). Nothing is ever held at pure white or pure black.
Entries settle exponentially with tau ~5 frames @30: a 17-frame rack focus, a 57 degree spin unwind with a 68% scale settle, a 73% zoom settle with a 10 px defocus.

Half the sections are built graphics rather than anime clips - a 3D now-playing card in a bokeh field, a cracked-glass memory space with a filmstrip and polaroids, a white infinite studio with flying letters, and a live-action laptop plate with extruded 3D text. Only 4 of the 8 sections are anime footage, all of them slow, wide and shallow so the type can own the frame.

There is no sound design at all: the song alone at -14.7 LUFS / -3.8 dBTP, with spectral flatness <= 0.003 everywhere, so no whooshes, no risers, no sweeps, no ducking. And no RGB split, no strobe, no dissolve, no shake, no speed ramps and no freeze frames.

method.downloads: yt-dlp <=1080p highest fps into C:/Users/Home/AppData/Local/Temp/edit-refs/fx/, copied to C:/Users/Home/Desktop/edit-refs/fx/ (av01 1080p30 + m4a, merged to mp4)
method.frame_analysis: analyze_ref.py at 320 px: every one of the 632 frames - motion-compensated difference and HSV histogram distance for cuts, DIS optical flow fitted with RANSAC for zoom / roll / pan, sharpness, luma percentiles, saturation, Lab split tone, vignette, grain, letterbox
method.features: general_features.py: blur anisotropy, radial-vs-tangential gradient ratio (zoom blur), red-blue phase correlation (RGB split), frame-to-frame correlation, strongest straight edges, centre luma
method.events: general_deep.py: per-shot table, per-cut curves from -6 to +8 frames, cut-to-transient offsets at 1.5 ms resolution and the beat subdivision each cut lands on
method.fx: fx_measure.py (new, written for this group): directional gaussian-equivalent blur from the 1-D power spectrum of the rows and of the columns, fitted with an explicit noise floor - a plain re-blur or Laplacian ratio is fooled by AV1 noise in a heavily blurred frame and reports "sharp". Calibrated against known gaussians it is accurate to ~5% up to 1.6% of the frame width and saturates above that. Also glow, warm highlight bias, highlight centroid, particle blob count, letterform area and bounding box
method.sheets: ref_sheets.py --every 1: contact sheets of all 632 frames (9 sheets) plus frame strips; fx_measure.py --strips: 480 px wide 4-column strips labelled with the measured blur, for 82:98, 104:120, 118:134, 144:160, 176:192, 192:208, 226:242, 286:302, 322:338, 376:392, 406:422, 468:504
method.audio: refine_audio.py for the beat grid (bpm and phase searched in 5 ms steps against the kick), demucs htdemucs stems for vocal / kick / snare / hat onsets, librosa spectral flatness and >8 kHz energy at 10 ms hops to look for whooshes and risers, ffmpeg loudnorm for LUFS and true peak
method.by_eye: every frame read on the contact sheets; the twelve strips read frame by frame against the measured curves; full-resolution crops of the type at f60, f153, f356, f488 to read the typeface, the glow and the extrusion
caveats: the blur estimator saturates above 1.6% of the frame width; the two or three most blurred frames of each transition are reported as ">= 1.7% W (saturated)" rather than a number
blur is undefined on frames with almost no contrast (the white-out peaks and the black frames): those are marked flat
for motion blur the per-frame displacement from the optical-flow fit is the more reliable number, and is what the recipes use (a 180 degree shutter smears by half of it)
one reference only: treat every pooled number as a single observation

lyric_fragments: just trust me, you'll be fine

shots.what: Spotify-style now-playing card in a bokeh field
Frieren, indoor close-up, shallow DOF, near-still
Frieren at night, snow, drifting handheld
sunset field with a torii gate, fast forward dolly

joins.kind: whip left to white -> hard cut at the peak -> speedline settle
whip left to black -> 4 dark frames -> the new shot brightens
radial push -> hard cut -> spin blur settle
luma ramp to white over 11 frames, the next shot is white anyway
dolly out to white -> hard cut -> zoom settle + 10 px defocus
linear fade to black over 10 frames

effects.name: fade_in_from_black
effects.beat_position: starts on the first downbeat (phase 0.06 s, -60 ms)

measured.shape: linear in luma, 9 frames = 0.30 s = 0.8 beats160
measured.camera: the card flies in from far: zoom -42 %/frame at f3 decaying to -1 %/frame by f11, pan x -21 %W at f2

effects.recipe: img * k, k = i/9 linearly, together with a scale ramp s(i) = exp(-0.42 * 0.72**i) toward 1.0; the incoming camera is the effect, the fade only rides on it

effects.name: bokeh_particle_field
effects.recipe: N ~ 60 defocused discs, radius 6..26 px @1920, colour (150,120,255)..(90,160,255), alpha 0.15..0.5, screen-blended; each disc gets a gaussian sigma = 0.35*radius so it reads as bokeh, not a dot

effects.name: card_3d_perspective_dolly

measured.net: the card starts small, rotated ~25 deg about Y and ~8 deg about X, and ends filling the frame at f72-79 before receding again
measured.perspective: true perspective: the far edge of the card is 0.72x the height of the near edge at f8, 0.93x at f60

effects.recipe: fx.card_quad(size, cx, cy, w, h, rx, ry, rz, focal=1.8) + fx.warp_to_quad; animate ry 26 -> 3 deg, rx 9 -> 2 deg, card width 0.34 -> 1.6 of the canvas over 80 frames, ease-out

effects.name: typewriter_lyric

measured.text: "Just trust me, You'll be fine" (29 chars)
measured.note: each new character appears at ~35% alpha and reaches full over 3 frames, so 2-3 trailing characters are always faint
measured.style: white, no glow, Spotify-lyric look on a cyan card, cap height 4.0% of picture height

effects.recipe: text.Sprite.crop_letters(n, frac): n = floor(since * 13.2), frac = frac_part; the engine already exposes anim="type" but with cps=24 fixed - this reference wants cps ~13

effects.name: defocus_recede_out
effects.beat_position: ends 4 frames (133 ms) before the percussion hit at f92; join phase 0.67 of the beat

measured.sigma_px_1920: 5.0 -> 6.2 px, i.e. a mild defocus, the darkening carries the exit

effects.recipe: cam_out(u): ln s = -sum of the ramp (the shot pushes AWAY, not toward); fx.gauss_px(img, pw(0.0032) * k) and fx.gain_u8(img, 1 - 0.64 * k**1.6), k = 1 - u/pre, pre = 8 frames @30

effects.name: hard_cut_on_blur
effects.beat_position: join phase 0.64 +- 0.12 of the 160 bpm beat (OFF the beat, see pooled_measurements.join_beat_phase)

measured.note: the cut is invisible because both sides are near-featureless

effects.recipe: a plain hard cut; the whole craft is that the outgoing is dark+defocused and the incoming is white+defocused, so no frame reads as a join

effects.name: rack_focus_in

measured.first_two_frames: beyond the estimator range: visually a full-face blur, sigma >= 1.7% W (>= 33 px @1920)
measured.shape: exponential decay, tau ~ 5 frames @30 after a 6-frame plateau

effects.recipe: fx_in(img, v): fx.gauss_px(img, pw(0.017) * exp(-max(0, v - 0.2)/0.17)) with the first 2 frames clamped to the max; NO gain pump (unlike the existing defocus_in which adds +20%)

effects.name: ink_blob_logo_reveal

measured.growth: the blot enters from the top, grows with organic fingers, covers ~35% of the frame by f119
measured.carried_text: the channel word mark fades up inside the blot at f109-116, text_area 7.2% -> 13.2%

effects.recipe: an organic mask: blob_mask(size, progress) style - a low-frequency noise field thresholded at a moving level, blurred 0.4% W; multiply the frame by (1 - mask) toward black and alpha_composite the word mark inside the mask with alpha = clamp((progress-0.15)/0.3)

effects.name: whip_pan_left_to_white
effects.recipe: cam_out(u): dx accumulates d(i) = 18 * 1.30**i px @1920 leftward; fx_out: fx.line_blur(img, 0.5 * d(i), angle=0) (180 deg shutter -> smear = half the per-frame move) then fx.fill_mix(img, (252,254,255), alpha(i)) with alpha(i) = 0.72 * (max(0, i-6)/8)**2

effects.name: hard_cut_at_white_peak

measured.note: the cut happens ON the brightest frame, not after a white hold; the incoming is immediately dark - the eye reads the blow-out, not the join

effects.recipe: no white hold frames at all (this is where WhiteOut differs: it holds 150 ms of pure white)

effects.name: speedline_streak_settle

measured.note: the new shot arrives as horizontal light streaks over black and resolves; the saturation ramp 8 -> 88 over 12 frames is what sells the "arrival"

effects.recipe: fx_in: fx.line_blur(img, pw(0.09) * exp(-v/0.13), 0) and fx.saturation_u8(img, 0.1 + 0.9 * min(1, v/0.4))

effects.name: word_3d_flythrough

measured.drift_px_per_frame: x +40, y +12 at 1920 (the word slides right and down as the camera passes it)
measured.typeface: geometric rounded sans, lowercase, single-storey a, near-circular o (Poppins / Century Gothic / Futura family)
measured.fill: pure white, peak 255, no stroke, no drop shadow
measured.words_coexist: up to 3 words are on screen at once at different depths (f172-179): the earlier words are still there, small, behind
measured.exit: the word leaves by passing the camera, motion blurred, never by fading

effects.recipe: per word keep a depth z; scale = f/(z - camera_z) so the growth is automatically exponential; blit with text.blit(..., scale) plus fx.line_blur on the SPRITE by 0.5 * |d(scale*size)|/frame; draw the words back-to-front so the near word occludes the far one

effects.name: text_outer_glow

measured.colour: white glow (same hue as the fill), screen blend

effects.recipe: text.STYLES entry glow=[(6, 0.57, None), (38, 0.07, None)] at 1920 wide (scale both radii by W/1920); the broad component is what makes it read as a light source instead of a sticker

effects.name: lens_flare_bloom

measured.behaviour: a bright source behind the subject blooms as the camera passes it, then is occluded

effects.recipe: fx.lens_flare(size, x, y, strength) screen-blended, strength ramped 0 -> 1 -> 0 over 7 frames; fx.bloom_boost(img, 0.35, threshold=0.62, sigma_frac=0.02) on top

effects.name: glass_shatter
effects.beat_position: starts +14 ms after the beat at f182; lasts 11 frames = 0.98 beats160

measured.edge_growth: x2.9 over 9 frames as the shards multiply
measured.warm_note: the light behind the broken plane is warm: R-B swings -11 -> +10 over 8 frames
measured.camera: a constant +2..+4 %/frame push while the plane breaks
measured.impact: frame 182 has a single bright radiating star (a ~20-arm crack) at the impact point

effects.recipe: precompute a Voronoi shatter: 45-70 seeds, cv2.Subdiv2D -> triangle/polygon shards; a radial crack star drawn first (20 white lines, 2 px, from the impact point, length ramped 0 -> 0.6 W over 3 frames, blurred 3 px); then per shard warp the frame by a small similarity that moves the shard outward and rotates it by rng(-8, 8) deg * k, drawing a warm (255,180,90) gap layer behind

effects.name: polaroid_cards_3d

measured.aspect: square photo with a wide bottom border (polaroid), white, ~2.5% border
measured.entry: each card flies in from off-screen right with motion blur, 4-6 frames apart
measured.perspective: true 3D: the cards are tilted about Y by 10-30 deg and occlude each other
measured.exit: at f400-413 the whole row recedes: scale -2.9 -> -5.6 %/frame while the frame whitens

effects.recipe: fx.bordered(still, 0.025) -> fx.card_quad + fx.warp_to_quad per card with its own ry/rz; fx.shadow_under for the drop shadow; sort by depth and composite back-to-front

effects.name: whip_pan_left_to_black

measured.note: the mirror image of whip_pan_left_to_white: the SAME exponential smear, but the ramp goes to black and there is a 4-frame dark hold that hides the join

effects.recipe: as whip_pan_left_to_white but fx.gain_u8(img, 1 - 0.71 * k**1.6) instead of fill_mix to white; hold 4 frames at luma <= 25 before the new shot brightens back

effects.name: radial_zoom_push_blur

measured.radtan_meaning: |grad . r| / |grad x r| about the centre; < 1 = smeared along the radius
measured.note: a SUSTAINED radial blur across whole 30-90 frame shots, not a 2-frame burst

effects.recipe: fx.zoom_blur_c(img, strength) per frame with strength = 0.9 * zoom_rate_per_frame (so 0.03 at 3 %/frame), steps 8, applied inside the shot camera rather than at the cut

effects.name: ground_plane_3d_text

measured.word: Chicago (only "c...go" is ever readable, the rest is under the camera)
measured.placement: lying FLAT on the ground plane of the shot, matching its perspective; the camera dollies forward over it and it exits under the bottom edge
measured.fill: white with a soft grey underside, slight ambient occlusion where it meets the grass
measured.blur: the text inherits the shot radial blur (radtan 0.79) - it is blurred exactly as much as the plate, which is what makes it sit in the scene

effects.recipe: render the word to a sprite, warp it with fx.card_quad(rx=78 deg) so it lies on the floor, then apply the SAME fx.zoom_blur_c strength used on the plate; alpha 0.9 and a multiply pass of the plate luminance under it for contact shadow

effects.name: spin_blur_entry
effects.beat_position: join at f292, 2 frames before the percussion hit at f294; join phase 0.83

measured.note: the incoming starts at ~x1.68 and rolled ~57 deg and unwinds
measured.rotational_blur: blur axis rotates with the content (blur_deg 9 -> 177 -> 165 -> 155 -> 144 -> 141 over the first 6 frames) - a true rot blur, not a linear smear

effects.recipe: cam_in(v): ln s = ln(1.68) * exp(-v/0.156), roll = -57 * exp(-v/0.156); fx_in: fx.rot_blur(img, roll_rate_deg_per_frame * 1.5)  [the existing spin_blur has the right shape but only 12-20 deg of roll and no coupled scale settle]

effects.name: crack_web_and_filmstrip_set

measured.backdrop: a dark plane covered in white spider-web cracks, lit by 4-6 small specular sparks
measured.filmstrip: a 35 mm strip with sprocket holes running diagonally across the frame at ~28 deg, carrying 6-8 anime thumbnails
measured.camera: slow dolly + roll -0.54 deg/frame, then a luma ramp to white

effects.recipe: crack layer: 60 random line segments from 8 seed points, 1-3 px, white, alpha 0.35, blurred 1 px, screen blended; filmstrip: an affine_layer strip texture with the thumbnails blitted into its frames

effects.name: luma_ramp_to_white_section

measured.alpha_shape: near linear with a slight ease-out; peak 0.83, NOT held as pure white
measured.after: the NEXT section stays at luma 217 for 83 frames - the white is a set, not a flash
measured.beat: the vocal onset of the chorus word "another" is at f328, mid-ramp, and the peak is 5 frames later

effects.recipe: fx.fill_mix(img, (255,255,255), alpha) with alpha = 0.83 * ease_out(i/11) combined with the same exponential line_blur as the whips; then CUT into a shot whose own background is white

effects.name: letters_fly_in_motion_blurred

measured.arrival_blur: each letter is smeared 60-140 px @1920 along its travel on its first 2 frames, then lands crisp
measured.typeface: condensed bold grotesque, UPPERCASE (Oswald / Archivo Narrow / Anton family)
measured.fill: dark charcoal with a warm bronze gradient toward the lit side (not flat black)

effects.recipe: per letter i: start x = 1.35 W, ease-out to its slot over 5 frames, delay i * 3 frames; fx.line_blur on the letter sprite by 0.5 * dx_per_frame; fill with a horizontal gradient from (45,45,50) to (150,120,70) BGR

effects.name: leaf_debris_particles

measured.drift: falling and tumbling, 3-12 px/frame, independent of the beat

effects.recipe: the existing particles overlay kind "petals" with a leaf sprite and colour (60,90,140) BGR, n ~ 70, opacity 0.9, plus per-particle rotation

effects.name: light_ray_streaks

measured.contrast: only 4-8 luma below the white background - extremely subtle

effects.recipe: fx.light_rays(img, x, y, strength=0.15) or a plain multiply of a few soft vertical bands at 0.97

effects.name: dolly_out_shrink_to_white

measured.note: the exit is a SCALE ramp, not a pan: the subject shrinks to nothing and the white background is all that is left

effects.recipe: cam_out: ln s ramp -0.03 -> -0.06 per frame; fx.gauss_px small + fill_mix to white alpha reaching 0.82

effects.name: hard_cut_whip_settle

measured.note: the biggest grade jump in the edit (white CG -> warm live-action), covered by a zoom-out settle and a 10 px defocus

effects.recipe: cam_in: ln s = ln(1.73) * exp(-v/0.18); fx_in: fx.gauss_px(img, pw(0.005) * exp(-v/0.18)) and fx.line_blur(img, pw(0.05) * exp(-v/0.08), 0)

effects.name: extruded_3d_text_in_scene

measured.extrusion: real 3D: 10-14% of the cap height of side wall, visible bevel, specular highlight on the top edge
measured.material: gold / cream, (150, 190, 225) BGR body with a (90, 140, 195) side wall
measured.occlusion: the letters pass BEHIND the laptop screen edge (true depth sorting)
measured.cast_shadow: soft, offset down-right by ~3% of the cap height, sigma ~2% W, alpha 0.35
measured.camera: a slow orbit, 0.03 deg/frame roll, 0.46 %/frame zoom - the text tracks it exactly

effects.recipe: text.STYLES extrude=(n, (dx, dy), colour) gets the silhouette right but has no light: add a second pass that lightens the top row of the extrusion stack and a fx.shadow_under for the cast shadow; occlusion needs a per-shot depth matte (layouts.subject_matte is the closest thing we have)

effects.name: fade_out_to_black

measured.lands: 5 frames after the percussion hit at f497

effects.recipe: fx.gain_u8(img, 1 - i/9); the edit ends here (f503), everything after is the creator end card

effects.name: watermark

measured.position: bottom left, x=0.02, y=0.955 of the picture box
measured.behaviour: static for the whole edit, never animated

effects.recipe: the existing watermark overlay, style "watermark", opacity 0.55

effects.name: letterbox_2to1

measured.constant: identical on every frame including the end card

effects.recipe: fx.letterbox_bars(img, 0.050) - note this is 2:1, not the 2.39:1 the cinematic styles use

pooled_measurements.note: one reference so far; every number is from WGvtliE1298 and should be re-pooled when more fx references arrive

join_beat_phase.meaning: fraction of the 160 bpm beat at which the frame join falls; 0 = on the hit
join_beat_phase.conclusion: joins sit on the OFF beat, never on it - general_deep agrees (subdivision share: beat 0.00, half 0.13, quarter 0.25, off 0.63)

text_to_vocal_lag_frames30.meaning: frames between the demucs vocal-stem onset of a syllable and the first frame on which its word is legible

effect_density_per_bar_by_section.note: intro: fade, bokeh, card dolly, typewriter
rack focus, ink wipe, whip-white, speedlines, 2 words, glow
2 words, flare, shatter, polaroids, whip-black, radial push
ground text, spin blur, crack set, white ramp, letters
letters, polaroid row, leaves, rays, dolly out

whip_growth_per_frame30.meaning: geometric growth of the per-frame displacement during a whip

flash_alpha_peak.note: never a full 1.0 white frame anywhere in the edit

dark_alpha_peak.note: the black counterpart of the same ramp

settle_tau_frames30.note: exponential time constant of every entry settle (defocus, roll, zoom)

entry_scale_pct.note: how much bigger the incoming starts than its settled size

defocus_peak_sigma_pct_w.note: plus two saturated frames per rack focus where sigma >= 1.7% W

text_cap_height_pct_of_picture.note: hero words are 2-4x bigger than anything in the other reference groups

radial_blur_radtan.meaning: < 1 = the picture is smeared along the radius

rgb_split_px_1920.conclusion: NO chromatic split anywhere - this style does not use it

grain.note: grain is inherited from the source, never added as a look

grade.split_tone: warm highlights (Lab b* +16..+18) with neutral-to-cool shadows in the outdoor shots; the interior shot is warm all through; the CG sets are neutral

concept: A typography edit, not a song edit: the SUBJECT of the video is the text. The anime footage is a backdrop that is deliberately slow, wide and out of focus so the lettering can own the frame.
The lyric drives everything. Words appear on their sung syllable (median 83 ms after the vocal onset), and the shot joins are hidden OFF the beat so nothing competes with them.
Every word lives in 3D space, not on a 2D overlay plane: it has a depth, the camera moves past it, it grows exponentially and it exits by passing the lens, motion blurred. It never fades out.
Half the "shots" are built graphics sets (a now-playing card, a cracked-glass memory space, a white studio) rather than anime clips. There are only 4 anime clips in 16.8 s.
Every join is hidden inside an extreme state - blown white, crushed black, 10 px of defocus or 300 px of smear per frame - so the viewer never sees a frame boundary.

formats.shorts_adaptation: for 1080x1920 the same grammar works if the hero word is kept at 13-25% of the PICTURE height and the fly-through axis is made vertical; the 2:1 bars become a 9:16 full frame with no bars

structure.intro: 0.0-2.9 s: a now-playing card with the first lyric typed on it
structure.body: 2.9-13.8 s: one word or phrase per lyric fragment, one graphics set per line
structure.outro: 13.8-16.8 s: the last phrase as extruded 3D text in a live-action plate, then a 10-frame fade to black
structure.length: 16.8 s of edit; a 4.3 s creator end card follows and is not part of the edit

cut_rules.beat_placement: NEVER on the percussion hit: join phase 0.64 +- 0.12 of the 160 bpm beat
cut_rules.rationale: the beat is carried by the word animation; a cut on the beat would double-hit
never: a visible hard cut between two sharp frames
a cut inside a word animation

camera.inside_shot: every shot moves: 0.5-3.0 %/frame zoom, 0.03-0.75 deg/frame roll, 1-38 px/frame pan at 1920
camera.blur: shots that push forward carry a SUSTAINED radial blur (radtan 0.72-0.79), not a burst
camera.settles: every entry settles exponentially with tau ~ 5 frames @30 (0.17 s)
camera.entry_scale: the incoming starts 68-73% bigger than its settled size
camera.handheld: none: all moves are smooth AE camera moves

families: exponential whip to white + hard cut at the peak + streak settle
exponential whip to black + 4 dark frames
radial push + hard cut + spin-blur settle (57 deg, tau 4.7 frames)
luma ramp to white into a shot whose own background is white
dolly-out shrink to white + hard cut + zoom settle with 10 px defocus
transitions.whip_law: displacement grows geometrically at x1.30-1.48 per frame for 8-14 frames, peaking at 11-17% of the frame width in one frame; the smear is half that (180 deg shutter)
transitions.flash_law: the white / black overlay reaches alpha 0.72-0.83 and is NEVER held: 0 pure white frames and 0 pure black frames in the whole edit

text.hero_typeface: geometric rounded sans, lowercase, for the in-scene 3D words (Poppins / Century Gothic)
text.set_typeface: condensed bold grotesque, UPPERCASE, for words on the white set (Oswald / Anton family)
text.extruded_typeface: heavy grotesque caps with a real bevel and specular, for the closing line
text.size: hero words 13-25% of the picture height; the lyric card line 4.0%; watermark 2.4%

colour.hero: pure white with a two-radius glow (sigma 0.31% W gain 0.57, sigma 2.0% W gain 0.07)
colour.set: dark charcoal with a warm bronze gradient toward the lit side
colour.extruded: cream / gold body with a darker side wall

animation.entrance: the word simply EXISTS in 3D and the camera reaches it, or its letters fly in from off-screen at 2-4 frame intervals with a 60-140 px smear
animation.exit: it passes the camera, motion blurred; it never fades out

text.sync: word legible 1-4 frames (median 2.5, 83 ms) after the vocal onset of its syllable
text.coexistence: up to 3 words on screen at once, at different depths, the earlier ones small and behind

grade.highlights: p98 175-254, the white set sits at luma 217
grade.split_tone: warm highlights (Lab b* +16..+18) over neutral or cool shadows outdoors; the interior plate is warm all through; the CG sets are neutral
grade.saturation: per shot 4 (white set) to 168 (the blue card) - the edit does NOT unify saturation
grade.grain: inherited from the source (0.32-0.51 on anime, 1.20 on the live plate, 0.00 on CG); never added
grade.vignette: 0.10-0.99 depending on the plate; no added vignette

particles: petals + dust in the sunset shot (142/frame)
tumbling leaves on the white set (48/frame, 227 at p90)
light: one lens flare bloom as the camera passes a light source
1-3 near-invisible vertical light rays on the white set
graphics: a 35 mm filmstrip across the frame
an ink blot carrying the channel word mark

audio.loudness: -14.7 LUFS integrated, -3.8 dBTP true peak, 19.3 LU range
audio.note: this is the single clearest difference from the sound-edit group: a typography edit adds NO sound design at all

what_works: wide, slow, atmospheric anime shots with a lot of empty sky, snow or field
shallow depth of field so the plate is already soft behind the type
shots whose own camera pushes forward, so the type can ride the same move
a dark or a blown-out area where the word can sit at full contrast
avoid: fast native cutting - the plate must hold 1-3 s
clip_selection.n_clips: 4 anime clips for 16.8 s; the other 4 sections are built graphics

whip_to_white.cam_out: dx accumulates d(i) = 18 * 1.30**i px @1920 in one direction (measured 18 -> 322 over 11 frames)
whip_to_white.cut: on the brightest frame, no white hold
whip_to_white.fx_in: fx.line_blur(img, pw(0.09) * exp(-v/0.13), 0); fx.saturation_u8(img, 0.1 + 0.9 * min(1, v/0.4))
whip_to_white.differs_from_engine: WhiteOut holds 150 ms of pure white and fades the incoming up from white; this one cuts at alpha 0.72 straight into a dark frame

whip_to_black.fx_in: the new shot brightens back over 8 frames (luma 24 -> 53)

defocus_recede_cut_rack_focus.cam_out: ln s ramps -0.031 -> -0.141 per frame (the shot pushes AWAY)
defocus_recede_cut_rack_focus.fx_in: fx.gauss_px(img, pw(0.017) * exp(-max(0, v - 0.2)/0.17)), first 2 frames clamped to the maximum; NO gain pump
defocus_recede_cut_rack_focus.differs_from_engine: DefocusIn is 6 frames @60 (0.1 s) and adds +20% gain; this is 17 frames @30 (0.57 s), peak sigma >= 1.7% W and flat exposure

spin_blur_settle.differs_from_engine: SpinBlur uses 12-20 deg of roll and no coupled scale settle; measured is 57 deg with a 68% scale settle on the same tau

luma_ramp_into_white_set.fx_out: fx.fill_mix(img, (255,255,255), 0.83 * ease_out(i/11)) with fx.line_blur growing 17 -> 211 px/frame
luma_ramp_into_white_set.cut: into a shot whose own background is white (luma 217), so the ramp never resolves back
luma_ramp_into_white_set.note: the anchor is the vocal onset of the chorus word, at the steepest point of the ramp, peak 5 frames later

zoom_out_settle_with_defocus.fx_in: fx.gauss_px(img, pw(0.005) * exp(-v/0.18)); fx.line_blur(img, pw(0.05) * exp(-v/0.08), 0)
zoom_out_settle_with_defocus.use: to cover the biggest grade jump in an edit (white CG set -> warm live plate)

sustained_radial_push.where: inside a shot, not at a cut
sustained_radial_push.fx: fx.zoom_blur_c(img, 0.9 * zoom_rate_per_frame, steps=8) every frame while the camera pushes 1.6-3.0 %/frame

word_3d_flythrough.geometry: give every word a depth z; scale = f / (z - camera_z), so the growth is exponential (measured x1.11 per frame, x2.34 over 8 frames)
word_3d_flythrough.draw: back-to-front so near words occlude far ones; up to 3 words alive at once
word_3d_flythrough.blur: fx.line_blur on the sprite by 0.5 * |position change| per frame
word_3d_flythrough.timing: the word becomes legible 1-4 frames after its vocal onset; it holds 2-8 frames and exits past the lens
word_3d_flythrough.size: cap height 10.8% -> 25.3% of the picture height across the fly-through

letters_fly_in.per_letter: start at x = 1.35 W, ease-out into its slot over 5 frames, delay i * 3 frames (measured 2-4)
letters_fly_in.blur: fx.line_blur on the letter by 0.5 * dx per frame (60-140 px @1920 on the first 2 frames)
letters_fly_in.fill: a horizontal gradient from (45,45,50) to (150,120,70) BGR, not flat black
letters_fly_in.background: a white set at luma 217, saturation 4

ground_plane_text.warp: fx.card_quad(rx ~ 78 deg) so the word lies on the floor of the plate, then fx.warp_to_quad
ground_plane_text.match: apply the SAME fx.zoom_blur_c strength the plate has, and multiply the plate luminance under the word for a contact shadow; without both it floats

glass_shatter.step1: frame 0: 20 white radiating cracks, 2 px, from the impact point, length ramping to 0.6 W over 3 frames, gaussian 3 px
glass_shatter.step2: a Voronoi of 45-70 seeds (cv2.Subdiv2D); each shard warps outward by k * 0.04 W and rotates by rng(-8, 8) * k deg
glass_shatter.step3: a warm (90,180,255) BGR gap layer behind the shards; measured R-B swings -11 -> +10 over 8 frames
glass_shatter.measured: mean gradient x2.9, small-blob count x11, luma -43% over 11 frames, camera pushing +2..+4 %/frame

ink_blot_logo_reveal.mask: low-frequency noise thresholded at a moving level, blurred 0.4% W, entering from one edge, reaching 35% coverage
ink_blot_logo_reveal.use: multiply the frame toward black inside the mask and composite the channel word mark inside it (alpha = clamp((progress-0.15)/0.3))

music_card_intro_3d.card: fx.card_quad(ry 26 -> 3 deg, rx 9 -> 2 deg), width 0.34 -> 1.6 of the canvas over 80 frames, ease-out
music_card_intro_3d.background: 60 bokeh discs, radius 6-26 px @1920, screen blended over black
music_card_intro_3d.lyric: typed at 13.2 cps with a 3-frame per-character fade
music_card_intro_3d.differs_from_engine: layouts.MusicCard is a flat 2D card at a fixed size with cps=24 and no bokeh

extruded_3d_text_in_plate.extrusion: side wall 10-14% of the cap height, body (150,190,225) BGR, wall (90,140,195), a lighter top edge
extruded_3d_text_in_plate.shadow: fx.shadow_under, offset down-right by 3% of the cap height, sigma 2% W, alpha 0.35
extruded_3d_text_in_plate.occlusion: the letters must pass behind a foreground object - needs a depth matte (layouts.subject_matte is the closest thing the engine has)
extruded_3d_text_in_plate.size: cap height 23.6% of the picture height

letterbox_2to1.note: 2:1, not the 2.39:1 the cinematic styles use

watermark.spec: channel name, bottom left (0.02, 0.955), cap height 2.4% of the picture height, white at 0.55 opacity, no glow, never animated

fade_out.fx: fx.gain_u8(img, 1 - i/9) over 10 frames, linear in luma

measure_with.frame_analysis: core/edit/refs/analyze_ref.py VIDEO --out DIR   (cuts, camera, grade, letterbox, audio)
measure_with.features: core/edit/refs/general_features.py VIDEO --raw RAW.json   (blur axis, radtan, rgb split, edges)
measure_with.events: core/edit/refs/general_deep.py RAW.json VIDEO   (shots, per-cut curves, beat subdivision)
measure_with.fx: core/edit/refs/fx_measure.py VIDEO --raw RAW.json --out DIR --strips a:b,c:d   (directional blur sigma from the 1-D spectrum with a noise floor, glow, warm, particles, letterform area; frame strips)
measure_with.compare: render our sample at the same fps, run the same four scripts on it, and put our frame strips next to the reference strips at the matching beat phase

targets.name: join beat phase
targets.target: median 0.55-0.75 of the percussion beat, no join within 0.12 of a hit

targets.name: text to vocal lag
targets.target: 1-4 frames @30 (33-133 ms) after the vocal-stem onset
targets.tool: demucs vocals + librosa onsets, see method.audio

targets.name: whip growth
targets.target: x1.25-1.50 per frame for 8-14 frames, peak 11-17% of the width in one frame

targets.name: flash alpha
targets.target: peak 0.70-0.85, zero pure-white and zero pure-black frames

targets.name: settle tau
targets.target: 4-6 frames @30 on every entry (defocus, roll, zoom)

targets.name: hero text size
targets.target: cap height 13-25% of the picture height

targets.name: text glow
targets.target: two components: sigma 0.3% W gain 0.55 and sigma 2% W gain 0.07

targets.name: rgb split
targets.target: |shift| < 1 px @1920 everywhere - this style must not glitch

targets.name: audio
targets.target: -14 LUFS +- 0.5, true peak < -1 dBTP, NO added sfx (spectral flatness <= 0.005)

targets.name: letterbox
targets.target: constant 5.0% bars for 16:9 output (2:1 picture); none for 9:16

targets.name: render budget
targets.target: < 20 min for a 9:16 short and < 90 min for a long video on 2 cores; measure locally with engine --cpus 2 and say so

quality_targets.judging: pass is >= 9/10 judged frame by frame against the reference strips, not on a single still: put our _fxstrip_a_b.jpg next to the reference _fxstrip_a_b.jpg for the same transition and compare the blur amount, the luma ramp and the text size frame by frame. 8.5 is a fail.

gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: transitions.Hard and DefocusIn exist; DefocusIn is 6 frames @60 with a +20% gain pump, the reference needs 17 frames @30, peak sigma >= 1.7% W and flat exposure - a parameter change, not new code

WhipHorizontal / WhipSlide exist but smear for only 3 frames at fixed 25/8/3% W; the reference ramps geometrically at x1.30-1.48 per frame for 8-14 frames to 11-17% W per frame. fx.line_blur is the right primitive; the envelope is what is missing

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: whip to white with the cut at the peak
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: WhiteOut and FlashWhite exist but both hold pure white frames and fade the incoming up out of white; the reference reaches alpha 0.72-0.83, holds nothing and cuts into a dark frame

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: whip to black with a dark hold
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: DipBlack / DipBlackStrobe cover it; needs alpha 0.71 rather than pure black and a 4-frame hold
SpinBlur exists with the right shape (rot_blur + unwind) but only 12-20 deg; the reference is 57 deg with a coupled 68% scale settle on the same tau 4.7 frames

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: sustained radial blur during a push
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: fx.zoom_blur_c exists and RadialZoomBurst uses it for 2-3 frames at a cut; nothing applies it as a per-frame in-shot look for a whole 30-90 frame push (radtan 0.72-0.79)
BlurBridge and PunchSettle cover it; the reference values are ln(1.73) with tau 0.18 s and a 10 px defocus

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: luma ramp into a white set
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: fx.fill_mix gives the ramp, but there is no scene/layout for a white infinite studio to cut into, and no transition whose ramp deliberately does not resolve
FadeIn and the fade overlay cover both
fx.letterbox_bars and the letterbox overlay take any frac; 0.050 is the reference value
text.Sprite.crop_letters(n, frac) and engine anim="type"; the engine hard-codes cps=24 and does not use frac, the reference is 13.2 cps with a 3-frame per-character fade
text.STYLES glow takes a list of (radius, alpha, colour); the measured pair is (0.31% W, 0.57) + (2.0% W, 0.07) - no style currently uses a broad second component

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: hero text at 13-25% of the picture height
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: text.render takes any size; no existing style goes above ~9%, so this is a preset value to add

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: 3D word fly-through (per-word depth, camera passes the word)
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: text.blit only does uniform scale + roll about the sprite centre. There is no depth per overlay, no perspective, no back-to-front ordering and no way for the camera move to drive the word scale. This is the single biggest gap: it is the core of the style

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: motion blur on a moving text sprite
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: text.blit has blur_y only (a vertical box blur). The reference smears every moving letter by half its per-frame displacement along its travel; fx.line_blur exists but is never applied to a sprite

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: letters flying in one at a time with a smear
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: engine anim="letters_3d" and "slam" already stagger letters (3 frames apart) and scale them in, but they arrive by rotating from a random direction with no directional blur and no per-letter gradient fill

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: text on the ground plane of a shot
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: fx.card_quad + fx.warp_to_quad can produce the perspective, but nothing warps a TEXT sprite that way, and nothing matches the plate blur or adds the contact shadow that makes it sit in the scene

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: extruded 3D text with a bevel, specular and cast shadow
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: text.STYLES extrude=(n, (dx, dy), colour) stacks offset copies, which gives the silhouette but no lit top edge, no material and no cast shadow; fx.shadow_under exists and is not wired to text

the overlay flag "behind" uses layouts.subject_matte (a GrabCut matte) to put text behind the subject; the reference needs a per-shot depth order for a hard object (a laptop edge), which the matte handles only roughly
no shard / crack transition anywhere. fx.poly_mask, fx.blend_mask and fx.warp_to_quad give the pieces to build it; a Voronoi (cv2.Subdiv2D) shatter plus a radiating crack star is new code
no crack / fracture layer generator

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: ink blot reveal carrying a word mark
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: fx.blob_mask and BlobWipe give an organic growing mask; nothing composites a logo inside the mask, and blob_mask grows from a corner rather than as a blot with fingers

PhotoCollage, CardTiltIn and the postcard layouts all build bordered cards with shadows, but on a flat paper plane; the reference tilts each card about its own Y axis in a shared 3D space with depth sorting
no filmstrip generator

layouts.MusicCard exists with the album square, title, artist, typed lyric line, channel line and waveform, but it is a flat 2D card at a fixed size; the reference flies a 3D-tilted card through a bokeh field for 2.9 s
the particles overlay has a "bokeh" kind; the reference density is 57 discs/frame at radius 6-26 px @1920 with a 0.35 x radius gaussian - a parameter set
particles kinds petals, gold_dust, sparkles, bokeh, embers cover these; the leaf sprite wants its own rotation, which the current particles do not do
the lens_flare overlay + fx.bloom_boost
the light_rays overlay (strength 0.15 for this style)

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: speed lines / streak settle on entry
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: fx.line_blur with an exponential decay plus a saturation ramp; BlurBridge already does the blur half

gaps_vs_current_engine.item: word timing driven by the vocal
gaps_vs_current_engine.detail: planners.py places words on beats. Nothing separates the vocal stem to find syllable onsets, and nothing offsets a word by the measured +2.5 frame lag. core/edit/music.py has beats and sections but no vocal onsets; core/edit/refs/general_music.py already runs demucs and could be reused
RGBSplitGlitch and the "+rgb" modifier exist - and this preset must switch them OFF: the reference has no chromatic split at all
sound_edit.py can place clip hits - and this preset must not use it: the reference is the song alone

not_observed: RGB split / chromatic aberration anywhere (|shift| < 1 px @1920)
a pure white or a pure black frame (the ramps peak at alpha 0.72-0.83)
strobe, invert, halftone or any frame-level flicker
speed ramps in the footage (every plate runs at its native speed)
added sound effects, risers, filter sweeps or ducking
a face filling the frame while a word is on screen
